counting.count_line: ml_explain, source creative_batch_9:<family>, n_tests = 1 per test

common.results: write-once: a screen / rep refuses to overwrite its results file and logs no second count line

stage2.k: derived in code (stage2_k) from results_P.json and results_KD.json
stage2.rule: k = number of Stage-1 advances among P1, P2, K1, D1, fixed when results_P.json and results_KD.json are both final; each Stage-2 test is judged when it finishes at the threshold alpha/k (one-sided alpha 0.05; strict p < alpha/k), in its Stage-1 direction, AND with the section 2.4 floor on the point estimate, every binding placebo (advance rate <= 1.5% at the same threshold) and every binding robustness check (section 2.6 'any advance or pass'; their p thresholds at alpha/k); the Holm step-down over the final Stage-2 p values is reported as a label only

uncertainty.small_g: cb2_weather.small_g_pvalue per way; p = max over declared ways

labels: no opportunity (gate fail with audit pass and >= 80% of SCREEN units source-available)
audit.rule: (market, day) with >= 1 Data API print in [14:00Z, 15:00Z): pmxt shows any event of the condition id in the span

d.P: size-weighted VWAP of all of that transaction's prints on the token; last fill (newest in API order) reported; side never used
d.dust: best bid or best ask size < the market's recorded orderMinSize (missing field: unavailable, counted)
d.dust_variant: share-or-$1: size < orderMinSize or size x price < 1 (reported only)
d.gd_counted_on: two-sided fresh market-minutes; units entering D1 (m_c available, next transaction found)
d.m_c: mid of the best bid and best ask among levels with size >= orderMinSize (unavailable if either side has none)
d.next_tx: first transaction hash among outcome-0 prints with ts in [u + 1 s, u + 600 s] (ties: earliest ts, then oldest in API order)
d.unit: market-minute u in [14:01Z, 15:00Z] on the outcome-0 token's book (two-sided, fresh, not crossed); at most one unit per dust episode per 5 minutes (the first)

days.market_day: start_epoch <= t and end_epoch >= t + 7 h (scheduled life)
days.order: days by sha256(seed|day); an ingress cap truncates evenly

decisions: RV on [t - 6 h, t) (freeze-check ruling d: keep the 6 h analogue of the design's 1-day RV; the declared print fetch is [t - 6 h, t + 7 h])
ingress cap 180 GB (freeze check M8): origin t = 14:00:00Z is the first instant of hour 14Z, so nearly every token needs the 13Z lookback (about 2x ingress per day)
open (long-dated) markets kept in the frame (freeze check M7)
D uses the outcome-0 token's book and prints (one unit per market-minute); both tokens' minute states are stored
Book events are kept as derived per-minute D states plus raw last_trade_price events of 14Z and of the 13Z lookback (ruling c); raw book JSON is not stored (0.15 GB output cap)

exclusion.keys: creative_batch9/exclusion_keys.csv.gz + exclusion_report.json (q0182); report disjointness_unverified -> K1, D1 not testable (counted)
exclusion.order: filters -> id / key drops -> <= 3 per event -> seeded sample -> event split

frame.keeps: binary with token ids; scheduled life [startDate, endDate) overlapping [2026-04-13, 2026-08-10) by >= 3 d; volume >= 10000 (end-of-life field, disclosed look-ahead in selection); not negRiskAugmented; not weather (fee_category or CB2-W text); not crypto Up/Down (CB1_UPDOWN_RE); not Pyth (resolutionSource host *pythdata.app)
frame.open_markets: kept (freeze check M7): long-dated markets still open are in the population; only data <= t enters a feature and no outcome is read
frame.query: Gamma /markets closed=true and closed=false (both; deduplicated by id), volume_num_min=10000, start_date_max=2026-08-07T00:00:00Z, end_date per UTC day in [2026-04-16T00:00:00Z, 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z) plus one window [2026-10-01T00:00:00Z, 2100-01-01T00:00:00Z), order id; a capped window is halved down to one hour (a still-capped hour is excluded, counted)

k.cell: RV >= SCREEN quantile 0.666667 of RV or SPR >= SCREEN quantile 0.666667 of SPR (numpy linear; feature values of eligible SCREEN origins only; frozen in the census)
k.fills: cb3_maker.quote_fills queue rule, depth = displayed size at the quote price (0 inside the spread), own = 50; YES-terms prints (complementary prints converted)
k.fills_through: binding bracket: cumulative strictly-through opposite volume in (t, t + life) >= 50
k.gk_counted_on: the units that enter K1 (cell, after the skew cut, prints available, mark available)
k.kill2: unskewed alone >= 0.5c with p < 0.01 -> 'CB3-B's maker result; skew not needed' (no advance)
k.mark: mid of the last taker-BUY and last taker-SELL YES prices in [t + 18000 s, t + 25200 s]; both required, else the origin's fills are unavailable
k.quotes: life [t, t + 7200 s], 50 shares each side; unskewed = touch; s = +1: bid + 1 tick if < best ask else bid, ask + 1 tick (if <= 1 - tick); s = -1 mirrored
k.rebate: reported only: economics.REBATE_SHARE x recorded fee rate x p(1 - p)

robustness.cost: trade-through fills keep the sign and >= half
robustness.latency: fills only from t + 60 s keep the sign and >= half
robustness.months: sign in >= 2/3 of months with >= 300 fills (none: unknown, not met)
robustness.top5: p and floor without the top 5 clusters of each way
robustness.weighting: pooled per filled share agrees in sign
robustness.worst_case: unavailable marks scored at -1 tick per filled share keep the sign and p

k.route_gate: skewed mean per filled share > 0 AND skewed mean net per origin (P&L / 100 posted shares, unfilled = 0) > 0
k.rv: log(rms of consecutive 600 s grid differences of the last-print YES price over [t - 21600 s, t) + 0.0001); >= 3 differences
k.skew_cut: |x6| >= SCREEN quantile 0.5 of |x6| over eligible SCREEN cell origins; else no skew (excluded from K1, counted)
k.spr: best ask - best bid of the outcome-0 token at t
k.state: outcome-0 token at t; fresh = latest event >= t - 3600 s; crossed or one-sided ineligible
k.statistic: per origin, mean mark-out per filled share by quote type; K1 = mean over origins with a skewed fill - mean over origins with an unskewed fill (cents); unit value = delta-method linearisation (origins equally weighted)
k.tick: latest pmxt tick_size_change with both clocks <= t, else Gamma orderPriceMinTickSize, else 0.01
k.x6: HB2 f_imb_6h on prints in [t - 6 h, t): sum(yes_side * size * price) / sum(size * price); clip [-1, 1] / 0.8578247852488129

mde_assumptions.use: reported only; never changes a floor

pmxt.clock_rule: an event is used at x iff timestamp <= x and timestamp_received <= x
pmxt.kept: origin states (both tokens), per-minute D states (both tokens), last_trade_price events of hour 14Z and of the 13Z lookback hour when read (with transaction_hash)
pmxt.lookback: per token, only when the token has no `book` event with both clocks <= t in hour 14Z
pmxt.reader: row groups pruned on market statistics, light columns first, heavy columns only for row groups with a matching row; never materialised

prints.wallet: HMAC hash only (strict loader, pinned fingerprint)
prints.window: [t - 6 h, t + 7 h] venue time, takerOnly

declared.results: write-once: screen-kd / rep-kd refuse an existing results file or an existing count line for the same hypothesis, before any computation

sample.sports: topic == 'sports' sampled into its own reported stratum, n_sports = min(pool, floor(0.15 n), round(n * pool share))

seal.drops: seal-time drops by id and key against every committed seal copy except CB9's own; sealed files never edited
seal.read_rule: holdout/ is opened only by rep-kd after K1 or D1 advanced and its Stage-1 result is recorded (trials line with the results sha256)

split.unit: Gamma event (first event id; market id if none)

stage2.rule: cb9_common.STAGE2_RULE (k derived by cb9_common.stage2_k; --stage2-k optional and must equal it)

stall.flow: kd-seal passes a books stall on (nothing sealed); the census copies the label; screen-kd logs K1, D1 with p = 1 (counted)
stall.labels: cb9_common.STALL_LABELS; upstream stalls copy the upstream label

wallet.hash: HMAC-SHA256(key, lower-cased proxyWallet), first 32 hex characters
wallet.key_file: ~/.arepo/wallet_hash_key (or AREPO_WALLET_HASH_KEY_PATH), mode 600, never created by CB9
